metadata.description: Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex: general-purpose tools, the dstack engineering workflow, and the studio skills that need a human in the room.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: General-purpose tools: conversation-history search, web-scraper, field-notes, and wizard scripts that walk a human through manual setup. The wizard skill is ported from mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: dstack
plugins.description: Rigorous engineering workflows: playbook routing, twenty-two principles, multi-reviewer design and review, and unslopped prose. Ported from cursor/plugins pstack.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop skills: get grilled on a decision, turn a blocked question into a questionnaire, mine yourself for writing fragments and shape them into an article, and chart work too big for one session as a map on Linear. Ported from mattpocock/skills.
